Definition: from G2596 and G3140; to testify against:--witness against.
BiblicalUsage: To witness against is to testify against, and at the trial the high priest stood and demanded what these witnesses testified against Jesus, and Pilate asked if He heard how many things they witnessed against Him. The witnesses came forward and the charges piled up, yet Jesus answered nothing, and the silence was louder than the testimony. The word belongs to the courtroom where the innocent was condemned.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the false witnesses prove the trial was already decided before it began, because truth needs no hired voices. I hold that Jesus' silence was His strength, and the day is coming when every false witness will answer for what he said.
